tools.name: list_achilles_cli_commands
tools.title: List Robot Chat Commands
tools.description: WebChat command catalog for a workspace robot.

tools.name: list_achilles_skills
tools.title: List Robot Skillsets
tools.description: Workspace skill inventory and effective conversation selection, or robot defaults when sessionId is omitted; includes policy version and active revision.

tools.name: set_achilles_skill_enabled
tools.title: Set Robot Skill Selection
tools.description: Change a qualified skill in the current conversation policy or robot defaults with optimistic policyVersion; source files are preserved.

tools.name: robot_create
tools.title: Create Robot
tools.description: Creates a persistent workspace robot with a globally unique name; requires the authenticated administrator role.

codingAgents.description: Available coding agents; defaults to Codex. The API supports multiple agents.

tools.name: robot_list
tools.title: List Robots
tools.description: Lists workspace robots, their descriptions, available skillsets and skill names/descriptions from SKILL.md frontmatter.

tools.name: robot_delete
tools.title: Delete Robot
tools.description: Deletes a stopped workspace robot and its persistent home; requires the authenticated administrator role.

tools.name: openDesktopForRobot
tools.title: Open Desktop for Robot
tools.description: Starts or reuses the robot desktop without ALA so its persistent coding-agent home can be configured; cwd is optional and defaults to the robot workspace.

tools.name: startDesktopTaskForRobot
tools.title: Start Desktop Task for Robot
tools.description: Queues a desktop task for the robot, streams ALA progress, and completes when ALA exits; the live Selkies URL is available through getSessionUrlForRobotDesktop.

skillSets.description: Comma-separated skillset IDs from robot_list. Choose by description; each ID expands to its listed skills. Omission mounts no skills in a delegated task, including when the target robot is default.

skillset.description: Alias for skillSets, accepting discovered skillset IDs.

skills.description: Optional comma-separated repository-id/skill names. Combined with the selected skillsets. Continuations retain the resolved selection.

tools.name: stopDesktopTaskForRobot
tools.title: Stop Desktop Task for Robot
tools.description: Stops ALA but preserves the live desktop.

tools.name: startBrowserTaskForRobot
tools.title: Start Browser Task for Robot
tools.description: Queues a browser task for the robot, streams ALA progress, and completes when ALA exits; the live Selkies URL is available through getSessionUrlForRobotBrowser.

skillSets.description: Comma-separated skillset IDs from robot_list. Choose by description; each ID expands to its listed skills. Omission mounts no skills in a delegated task, including when the target robot is default.

skillset.description: Alias for skillSets, accepting discovered skillset IDs.

skills.description: Optional comma-separated repository-id/skill names. Combined with the selected skillsets. Continuations retain the resolved selection.

tools.name: stopBrowserTaskForRobot
tools.title: Stop Browser Task for Robot
tools.description: Stops ALA but preserves the live browser.

tools.name: startSimpleALATaskForRobot
tools.title: Start Simple ALA Task for Robot
tools.description: Queues a non-GUI ALA task for the robot, streams progress, and completes when ALA exits.

skillSets.description: Comma-separated skillset IDs from robot_list. Choose by description; each ID expands to its listed skills. Omission mounts no skills in a delegated task, including when the target robot is default.

skillset.description: Alias for skillSets, accepting discovered skillset IDs.

skills.description: Optional comma-separated repository-id/skill names. Combined with the selected skillsets. Continuations retain the resolved selection.

tools.name: stopSimpleALATaskForRobot
tools.title: Stop Simple ALA Task for Robot
tools.description: Stops the active simple ALA task.

tools.name: resumeTaskForRobot
tools.title: Resume Task for Robot
tools.description: Continues the exact saved ALA conversation after completion or interruption, with an optional new prompt; GUI tasks re-observe the current screen.

tools.name: getTaskStatusForRobot
tools.title: Get Task Status for Robot
tools.description: Returns the active or most recent task status.

tools.name: getSessionUrlForRobotDesktop
tools.title: Get Desktop Session URL
tools.description: Returns the authenticated live desktop URL.

tools.name: getSessionUrlForRobotBrowser
tools.title: Get Browser Session URL
tools.description: Returns the authenticated live browser URL.

tools.name: stopDesktopContainerForRobot
tools.title: Stop Desktop Container
tools.description: Stops and removes the desktop and its MCP bridge.

tools.name: stopBrowserContainerForRobot
tools.title: Stop Browser Container
tools.description: Stops and removes the browser and its MCP bridge.

tools.name: sendMessageToRobotTask
tools.title: Send Message to Robot Task
tools.description: Sends a prompt to an active robot task; returns whether the backend accepted it or queued it for the next turn.

tools.name: roboflow_list_workflows
tools.title: List Workflow Types
tools.description: Lists the RoboFlow workflow types (team configurations of robots, skills and execution types) available in the workspace.

tools.name: roboflow_create_workflow
tools.title: Create Workflow Type
tools.description: Creates a RoboFlow workflow type that declares which robots participate, their skillsets/skills and terminal or GUI execution type; requires the authenticated administrator role.

tools.name: roboflow_delete_workflow
tools.title: Delete Workflow Type
tools.description: Deletes a RoboFlow workflow type; requires the authenticated administrator role. Existing task flows keep their captured configuration.

tools.name: roboflow_create_flow
tools.title: Create Task Flow
tools.description: Creates a RoboFlow task flow for a user objective from a workflow type in a workspace folder; returns the flow id used by the monitoring page and the invoke tool.

tools.name: roboflow_list_flows
tools.title: List Task Flows
tools.description: Lists RoboFlow task flows, optionally filtered to one workspace folder.

tools.name: roboflow_get_flow
tools.title: Get Task Flow
tools.description: Returns one RoboFlow task flow with its invocation summaries (the final message of each robot run), without the full logs.

tools.name: roboflow_invoke_member
tools.title: Invoke Workflow Member
tools.description: Invokes a configured workflow member robot with an instruction, waits for the robot run to finish, and returns only that run's final summary; full logs stay on the flow.

tools.name: roboflow_finish_flow
tools.title: Finish Task Flow
tools.description: Marks a RoboFlow task flow as done with a final result; only the managing copilot decides when a flow is complete.

tools.name: roboflow_stop_flow
tools.title: Stop Task Flow
tools.description: Stops a RoboFlow task flow and cancels its active robot run.
